Name: Magician
Effect: This Pokémon will steal the Held Item of an opposing Pokémon it just hit with a Physical or Special Move. If it already has a Held Item you may choose to switch it for the one it stole. For information on held Items see p.83.
Description: This Pokémon excells at performing simple magic tricks that amaze others, such as conjuring and vanishing objects nearby in the blink of an eye.
